quality.reason: Well-structured report with tickers, engagement metrics, links and scores, but it leaks LLM preamble ('Now here's the formatted Discord report:'), and the underlying tweets are hype-driven hype with minimal substantive analysis, limiting real actionable value.

Well-structured digest with useful fleet health, PnL metrics, an active signal, and relevant news, but malformed ticker tags ([[]], escaped quotes) reduce actionability and the single signal is weak (0.41).

Well-structured report with actionable position status, quantified strategy health scores with historical trend data (ETH 83.5→69.6→75.8), and flagged anomalies like stochastic falling out of top 10, providing genuine decision-support signal rather than noise.

Well-formatted market table with one genuine signal (HYPE 84% bid-weighted orderbook), but the core whale alerts are false positives firing on tiny ~$103K trades (not whale-sized) and are duplicated at top and bottom.

Well-structured daily digest with trend deltas, clear status flags surfacing failing components (meta ❌ 45.8, paper_trader ⚠️ 51.2) and a stale trading system (no trades since May 22), giving real triage value despite lacking explicit remediation steps.

Well-structured digest with on-topic papers, internally consistent metadata (Aug 2026 scan matching arXiv ID 2608.xxxxx), verifiable links, and transparent methodology fallback disclosure; only minor deductions for truncated abstract text and inability to assess full breadth from the 500-char preview.
